snippet.title: Starcorp Tycoon – Singleplayer Gameplay Trailer | Early Access
snippet.description:
Build your corporate empire in the year 2246. Your fine is unpayable. Your sentence: run Starcorp.

Starcorp Tycoon is a sci-fi business simulation where you compete for customers across the stars. Start with Gulst, develop a better product, expand to new worlds and outsmart up to seven rival corporations.

In this singleplayer gameplay trailer:
• Choose your CEO and begin your Corporate Service.
• Set prices, track production costs and research new technologies.
• Scan star systems, survey worlds and find new markets.
• Build factories and labs, manage robots, and secure metal and water.
• Send sales agents, launch campaigns and win market share.
• Take on scenarios with different goals and starting conditions.

FREE DEMO: three games of 60 minutes each.
EARLY ACCESS: available now on the website for Windows and macOS.
STEAM: coming soon with v1.0.

Actual gameplay captured from Early Access v0.9.5. Includes cinematic sequences. Features and visuals may change during development.

Developed by VDIW Game Studios.

#StarcorpTycoon #TycoonGame #IndieGame
